construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit PRE23-226 (Prelim - Focused (Policy Review, No Plans), folder year 2023), status Complete: "SB330 Preliminary Application to construct a multifamily residential townhome project totaling 85 units"

City of San Jose permit H24-026 (Site Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2024), status Inactive: "Development Permit to allow demolition of 103,197-square-foot commercial building and the removal of 132 trees for the construction of 101 residential units in nine buildings on an approximately 3.86-gross acre site."

City of San Jose permit T24-018 (Tentative Map, folder year 2024), status Under Review: "Vesting Tentative Map to subdivide one existing lot into six residential lots, with each lot designated for condominium purposes for up to 101 residential units, on an approximately 3.68-gross-acre site."

SF YIMBY (May 2024) describes the existing building as a vacant six-floor office block to be demolished and says the developer invoked SB 330 in a May 2024 pre-application; the number and income levels of affordable units were not specified.
